entries.title: Micah 4:1
segments: ¶Now it shall come to pass in the latter days [That] the mountain of the LORD'S house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And peoples shall flow to it.

entries.title: Micah 4:2
segments: Many nations shall come and say, "Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths." For out of Zion the law shall go forth, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

entries.title: Micah 4:3
segments: He shall judge between many peoples, And rebuke strong nations afar off; They shall beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruning hooks; Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, Neither shall they learn war any more.

entries.title: Micah 4:4
segments: But everyone shall sit under his vine and under his fig tree, And no one shall make [them] afraid; For the mouth of the LORD of hosts has spoken.

entries.title: Micah 4:5
segments: For all people walk each in the name of his god, But we will walk in the name of the LORD our God Forever and ever.

entries.title: Micah 4:6
segments: "In that day," says the LORD, "I will assemble the lame, I will gather the outcast And those whom I have afflicted;

entries.title: Micah 4:7
segments: I will make the lame a remnant, And the outcast a strong nation; So the LORD will reign over them in Mount Zion From now on, even forever.

entries.title: Micah 4:8
segments: ¶And you, O tower of the flock, The stronghold of the daughter of Zion, To you shall it come, Even the former dominion shall come, The kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem."

entries.title: Micah 4:9
segments: Now why do you cry aloud? [Is there] no king in your midst? Has your counselor perished? For pangs have seized you like a woman in labor.

entries.title: Micah 4:10
segments: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, Like a woman in birth pangs. For now you shall go forth from the city, You shall dwell in the field, And to Babylon you shall go. There you shall be delivered; There the LORD will redeem you From the hand of your enemies.

entries.title: Micah 4:11
segments: Now also many nations have gathered against you, Who say, "Let her be defiled, And let our eye look upon Zion."

entries.title: Micah 4:12
segments: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD, Nor do they understand His counsel; For He will gather them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

entries.title: Micah 4:13
segments: "Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion; For I will make your horn iron, And I will make your hooves bronze; You shall beat in pieces many peoples; I will consecrate their gain to the LORD, And their substance to the Lord of the whole earth."
